node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-one quadratic color resultant
node.statement: The pointwise equations for a quadratic colored Frobenius interpolant give an explicit degree-six polynomial R_E in the color. This excludes the complete m=16,h=15 quadratic stratum because fourteen roots require at least seven distinct colors. At m=8,h=7, R_E exactly equals the six-color multiset polynomial, including collision multiplicities.
node.notes: Complete proof close of color degree two at h=15 and an exact color-multiset router at h=7. The h=7 coefficient systems and all assignment/cyclotomic/inner tests remain open.
